programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E13 Pingu et Pinga font du camping | Pinga a le hoquet | Tel père, tel Pingu
programme.desc: S2:E13 Pingu et Pinga font du camping | Pinga a le hoquet | Tel père, tel Pingu - Pingu et Pinga dorment sous une tente et Pingu essaie de lui faire peur. | Pinga a le hoquet et Pingu essaie de le faire partir en l'effrayant. | Pingu accompagne papa à la pêche et découvre que papa ne sait pas tout.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E14 Les sculptures de glace de Pingu | Le ballon de Pinga | Pingu et le groupe
programme.desc: S2:E14 Les sculptures de glace de Pingu | Le ballon de Pinga | Pingu et le groupe - Tout le monde participe au concours de glace, sauf Pingu. | Pingu et papa essaient de gonfler un ballon, mais c'est dur. | Pingu et Pinga rendent maman folle en utilisant tout comme tambour.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E15 Pingu et la machine à tricoter | Les ombres du soir de Pingu | Pingu joue à chat
programme.desc: S2:E15 Pingu et la machine à tricoter | Les ombres du soir de Pingu | Pingu joue à chat - Pingu veut utiliser la machine à tricoter de maman. Pingu croit s'être échappé, mais il se retrouve coincé.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E16 Pingu et les autocollants | Pingu et la sonnette | Le numéro d'équilibre de Pingu
programme.desc: S2:E16 Pingu et les autocollants | Pingu et la sonnette | Le numéro d'équilibre de Pingu - Pingu et Pinga trouvent des autocollants dans leur boîte de céréales et commencent à étiqueter des objets. | Pingu sait qu'il a des ennuis quand il casse la sonnette de l'igloo. | Robby est extrêmement doué pour faire tenir un poisson en équilibre sur le bout de son nez.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E17 Pingu se perd | Les crêpes de Pingu | Pingu qui pue
programme.desc: S2:E17 Pingu se perd | Les crêpes de Pingu | Pingu qui pue - Pingu fait tomber une bouteille de lait qui roule dans un ravin glacé. |Pingu fait des crêpes, mais la pâte vole partout en essayant de les retourner. | Maman sert de la bouillie de poisson pour le dîner – et Pingu n'aime pas du tout l'odeur !

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E18 Pingu et la boule de neige | Pingu et le tuyau | Pingu potier
programme.desc: S2:E18 Pingu et la boule de neige | Pingu et le tuyau | Pingu potier - Pingu découvre que plus il fait rouler ses boules de neige, plus elles deviennent grosses. | Pingu utilise un tuyau et un entonnoir pour jouer des tours à sa famille et à ses amis. | Pingu essaie la poterie de son grand-père, mais ses créations sont moins réussies.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E19 Le nouveau chapeau de maman | Pingu et les déchets | L'académie de luge de Pingu
programme.desc: S2:E19 Le nouveau chapeau de maman | Pingu et les déchets | L'académie de luge de Pingu - Quand Pingu et Pinga jouent trop brutalement, ils abîment le nouveau chapeau de maman. | Pingu jette son emballage, tout le monde l'imite et le stand de snacks devient un dépotoir. | Pingu est un peu casse-cou quand il s'agit de faire de la luge.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E20 Le pauvre Pingu | Pinga dans une boîte | Pingu et le cadeau
programme.desc: S2:E20 Le pauvre Pingu | Pinga dans une boîte | Pingu et le cadeau - Pingu est jaloux de l'attention que reçoit sa sœur malade... alors il fait semblant d'être malade aussi ! | Pingu et Pinga décident de faire une blague surprise à maman en mettant Pinga dans une vieille boîte. | Pingu est invité à une fête d'anniversaire, mais il ne veut pas que Pinga vienne aussi.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E21 Pingu et le papier mâché | Pingu a mal au ventre | Pingu s'emballe
programme.desc: S2:E21 Pingu et le papier mâché | Pingu a mal au ventre | Pingu s'emballe - Le professeur de Pingu montre à la classe comment fabriquer des formes en papier mâché, et Pingu et ses amis sont impressionnés. | Pingu ne peut pas se passer de ses en-cas au poisson préférés. | Papa donne une leçon de conduite à Pingu, mais Pingu casse accidentellement le levier de vitesse.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E22 Pingu et le magasin de jouets | Pingu et l'animal de l'école | Pingu chouchouté
programme.desc: S2:E22 Pingu et le magasin de jouets | Pingu et l'animal de l'école | Pingu chouchouté - Pingu veut un nouveau jouet, mais maman refuse de lui en acheter lors de leurs courses. | Pingu est chargé de s'occuper de l'animal de compagnie de l'école. C'est un crabe grincheux qui n'aime pas Pingu. | Pingu sème le chaos lorsqu'il est obligé d'accompagner maman au salon de beauté.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E23 Pingu s'emmitoufle | Pingu et la flûte en poisson | Pingu jaloux
programme.desc: S2:E23 Pingu s'emmitoufle | Pingu et la flûte en poisson | Pingu jaloux - Quand Pinga se cogne l'orteil, Pingu s'amuse beaucoup à bander son pied douloureux et à la faire rire. | Pingu trouve une flûte magique, mais personne ne semble apprécier ses bruits stridents... sauf les poissons ! | Pingi semble préférer jouer avec Pingo plutôt qu'avec Pingu.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E24 La grosse prise de Pingu | Pingu et les bretelles | Pingu et l'igloo quotidien
programme.desc: S2:E24 La grosse prise de Pingu | Pingu et les bretelles | Pingu et l'igloo quotidien - Pingu promet d'attraper un GROS poisson pour maman, mais aux trous de pêche, il ne remonte que des déchets ! | Pingu teste l'élasticité des bretelles de grand-père en courant jusqu'à être propulsé en arrière. | Pingu obtient un travail de distribution de journaux et est impatient de commencer.

programme.title: Les Blaguo-shirts
programme.desc: Sam et Carly organisent une vente aux enchères avec tout un tas d'objets qui leur ont servi pendant l'émission iCarly. Le t-shirt rigolo remporte un succès.

programme.title: Le roi de la blague
programme.desc: Carly n'a jamais fait de blague et demande à Spencer de l'aider. Il fini par accepter, mais ses vieux démons le rattrapent. Lorsqu'il était en troisième, on l'appelait le roi de la blague, jusqu'au jour où.

programme.title: Sam et sa mère
programme.desc: Freddie filme un vol au Groovy Smoothie, permettant d'identifier le criminel. Mais les journalistes révèlent le nom et l'adresse du jeune garçon en direct.

programme.title: Pitié pour Nevel!
programme.desc: Nevel, l'ennemi numéro un de iCarly vient de se ridiculiser sur le net en criant sur une petite fille dans un supermarché... Désormais tout le monde le déteste, pour la plus grande joie de la bande d'iCarly.

programme.title: Le stagiaire
programme.desc: L'émission a de plus en plus de succès et le groupe a donc de plus en plus de travail. Ils décident d'engager un stagiaire pour les aider.

programme.title: lance la guerre des fans
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly va enfin pouvoir assister au Webicône cette année, ils vont même y faire une grande Conférence questions-réponses pour échanger avec leurs fans...

programme.title: lance la guerre des fans
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly va enfin pouvoir assister au Webicône cette année, ils vont même y faire une grande Conférence questions-réponses pour échanger avec leurs fans...

programme.title: Révélation
programme.desc: Brad devient le nouveau stagiaire de l'émission. Freddie et lui créent une application pour Pear Pad : le testeur d'humeur. Freddie l'utilise sur Sam et découvre qu'elle est amoureuse.

programme.title: En couple avec Sam et Freddie
programme.desc: Sam et Freddie sortent ensemble pour la plus grande joie de Carly qui est ravie de voir ses deux amis amoureux après s'être détestés toutes ces années.

programme.title: En couple avec Sam et Freddie
programme.desc: Sam et Freddie sortent ensemble pour la plus grande joie de Carly qui est ravie de voir ses deux amis amoureux après s'être détestés toutes ces années.

programme.title: Insupportable!
programme.desc: La relation entre Sam et Freddie commence à peser sur tout le monde ! Gibby devient le souffre-douleur attitré de Sam, Carly se fait évincer de la caméra, et aussi des sorties avec ses amies.

programme.title: Je taime
programme.desc: Carly suggère à Freddie et Sam de passer plus de temps ensemble et d'apprendre à se connaître. Sam ira donc jouer au petit train avec Freddie et ses copains et Freddie accompagnera Sam visiter son oncle et son cousin en prison. Mais c'est un échec.

programme.title: Lintello
programme.desc: Carly rencontre Kyle, un garçon très intelligent. Pour ne pas paraître stupide à ses yeux, elle étudie et fait des recherches sur Internet avant leur rendez-vous.

programme.title: rencontre la Première Dame des États-Unis
programme.desc: Carly se réjouit de revoir son père qui rentre fêter son anniversaire avec elle et Spencer. Malheureusement, la jeune fille déchante très vite quand elle apprend que son père ne pourra finalement pas rentrer.

programme.title: Nora, à la folie Pt1
programme.desc: Incarcérée pour avoir kidnappé et torturé la bande d'iCarly, Nora Dershlit est sur le point d'obtenir une libération conditionnelle.

programme.title: Je suis vivant!
programme.desc: Un journaliste américain placé temporairement en Europe centrale recherche sa nouvelle petite amie, qui a soudainement disparu.

programme.title: Dans l'oeil du tigre
programme.desc: Dans le comté de Montgomery, Kelly Taylor est prête à entrer à l'université et emmène son frère autiste, Tom, dans un établissement spécialisé. Cependant, la banque l'informe qu'elle n'a pas suffisamment de fonds sur son compte pour honorer son chèque. Son beau-père, Johnny Gaveneau, a retiré l'argent de son compte la veille. Lorsque Kelly rentre chez elle, Johnny lui révèle qu'il a utilisé cet argent pour acheter un tigre pour son projet de safari show . De plus, il a fait renforcer la maison afin de la protéger des ouragans, et toutes les fenêtres et portes extérieures sont recouvertes de bois. Lorsque Kelly se réveille, elle découvre que le tigre affamé se trouve à l'intérieur de la maison et qu'elle et Tom sont piégés avec l'animal vorace.

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln Contre Les Zombies
programme.desc: Durant la guerre civile, Abraham Lincoln apprend qu'une menace pèse sur l'avenir des États-Unis. Une armée de morts-vivants sudistes erre sur la surface du continent. En passant derrière les lignes ennemies, le Président se donne pour mission de détruire les zombies...

programme.title: Ghost bastards
programme.desc: En octobre 2012, une vidéo est retrouvée au domicile de Malcolm Johnson et les enregistrements restent inexpliqués. Après ce prologue, l'histoire se déroule sous forme de flashback. Durant l'été 2012, Malcolm et Kisha emménagent ensemble et commencent une vie heureuse. Une nuit, Kisha remarque quelques phénomènes inexpliqués qui la convainquent que leur maison est hantée par des fantômes. Pour la rassurer, Malcolm engage une équipe de tournage pour filmer l'intérieur de la maison jour et nuit. Quelques nuits plus tard, Malcolm et Kisha ont des relations sexuelles devant la caméra, malgré les protestations de Kisha. En visionnant la vidéo le lendemain, ils remarquent plusieurs phénomènes paranormaux capturés sur la bande. Malcolm veut vendre la maison, mais le marché immobilier est lent. Il décide donc d'engager un médium pour enquêter. Après que Kisha avoue avoir conclu un pacte avec le diable pour une paire de chaussures, certaines choses commencent à s'expliquer, mais cela ne résout pas les problèmes causés par les phénomènes paranormaux.

programme.title: Fabuleuses Aventures à Oz
programme.desc: La jeune Dorothée part pour le monde de OZ avec un groupe d'amis.

programme.title: Cooper, un amour de chien!
programme.desc: Un chien parvient à nouer des liens avec un homme bouleversé par la mort de son épouse et de ses enfants dans un accident de la route.

programme.title: Les Lunnis et leurs Aventures Magiques
programme.desc: Marie est une jeune fille pleine d'imagination grâce aux contes racontés par son grand-père. Un jour, le méchant Crude découvre le moyen d'en finir avec le Livre magique qui contient toutes les histoires inventées par l'Humanité et son gardien Lucrecia.

programme.title: L'Odyssée d'Albert: Chapitre 1
programme.desc: Chris, un adolescent aventureux, aide un gentil dinosaure à échapper aux griffes d'un scientifique fou, le docteur Jost, qui veut utiliser l'animal à des fins d'expérimentation.

programme.title: Aladin et la lampe magique
programme.desc: A l'aide d'une lampe magique, un jeune homme pauvre se transforme en prince afin de conquérir le cœur d'une belle princesse.

programme.title: Monster Island
programme.desc: Pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale, après le torpillage d'un navire japonais, deux ennemis échouent sur une île déserte où ils sont traqués par une créature monstrueuse.

programme.title: The Last Champion
programme.desc: Un ancien lutteur de championnat est contraint de faire face à son passé lorsqu'il retourne dans la ville natale qu'il a quittée en disgrâce vingt ans plus tôt. Peut-il devenir le héros que sa ville attendait ou restera-t-il prisonnier de ses erreurs passées ?

programme.title: Shadow Master
programme.desc: Un justicier reçoit la mission de combattre un groupe de démons, les Cavaliers de l'Apocalypse, qui veulent enlever de jeunes enfants pour répandre le Mal sur terre et faire advenir la fin des Temps.

programme.title: Dark Game
programme.desc: Un détective se lance dans une course contre la montre pour arrêter un jeu télévisé sur le dark web, où les captifs sont forcés de s'affronter pour rester en vie.

programme.title: Le ballet
programme.desc: Ce film est l'histoire et le déroulement d'un ballet à l'Opéra Garnier, depuis l'ouverture musicale jusqu'au tomber de rideau. Il est plein d'anecdotes et de tableaux : les danseurs, le public présent dans la salle ce soir là, l'orchestre, les techniciens en coulisses, la scénographie tout ce qui compose un spectacle à l'opéra et donc pas seulement ce qui se passe sur scène...

programme.title: Fol Amor
programme.desc: Une châtelaine et un jeune chevalier batifolent dans la forêt lorsqu'ils découvrent Excalibur. Ils se lancent alors dans un jeu de séduction délirant.

programme.title: Meet Meat
programme.desc: Un chasseur de baleine machiavélique se retrouve embarqué dans une course poursuite. Balloté entre vie et mort, le chasseur se retrouve bientôt chassé.

programme.title: Nebula
programme.desc: Dans une forêt en montagne, une petite fille fait une mystérieuse rencontre.

programme.title: Que dalle
programme.desc: Steven, Sandrine, Joël et Thomas tournent en rond. Du stade à la décharge, en passant par l'aire de jeu et le parking du supermarché rien ne semble réussir à les distraire.

programme.title: Le cadavre du Père-Noël bouge encore
programme.desc: Quand Julie et Antoine, parents délicieusement modernes et aimants, réalisent que leur fille Pia est sous l'influence de la petite Valentine qui sait tout sur la Chose, ils sont prêts à s'asseoir sur quelques principes afin que leur enfant retrouve le droit chemin.

programme.title: Journal d'un frigo
programme.desc: En 1971, un couple achète d'occasion un vieux frigo des années cinquante. Celui-ci prend place tout naturellement dans la cuisine du jeune ménage avant d'occuper une place centrale dans la vie de cette famille, et d'être le témoin privilégié de ses moments et événements tant ordinaires qu'exceptionnels.

programme.title: Le petit blond avec un mouton blanc
programme.desc: C'est la rentrée des classes. Le petit Pierre s'évade de la grisaille de l'école à l'occasion d'une rédaction. Il se replonge alors dans les souvenirs joyeux de ses vacances en compagnie de son mouton.

programme.title: Pour ton bien
programme.desc: Mi-ange, mi-démon, Brahim Omri mène tout son petit monde à la baguette. En sixième dans un collège de zone à éducation prioritaire, il sèche les cours, subtilise les bulletins d'absence, intercepte et détruit tout courrier accusateur...

programme.title: Petite escapade
programme.desc: Un enfant venu du centre de la forêt, observe du haut d'un mur les gens qui empruntent un trottoir. En fin de journée, il rentre chez lui, souriant. Il a une vision toute personnelle de ses observations du haut du mur.

programme.title: L'homme torche
programme.desc: Maurice, soixante-quinze ans, adore les bandes dessinées. Un jour, il décide d'être l'homme torche.

programme.title: Le trop petit prince
programme.desc: Lorsque le soleil se lève à l'horizon, un petit homme maniaque s'évertue, avec ténacité et par tous les moyens possibles, à nettoyer les tâches du bel astre lumineux.

programme.title: Mon petit frère de la lune
programme.desc: Une petite fille essaie de comprendre pourquoi son petit frère autiste n'est pas vraiment comme les autres enfants.

programme.title: Allez hop !
programme.desc: Une jeune femme monte sur un plongeoir. En se rapprochant du bord, elle se met à hésiter. Plus elle attend, plus la peur monte en elle. Dans sa tête, défile toute une série d'excuses pour éviter de se lancer. Jusqu'à ce que...

programme.title: Kroak
programme.desc: Kroak part à la recherche de nourriture, avec l'envie d'un morse pour le repas. Il creuse pour briser la glace et tombe nez à nez avec un ours.

programme.title: La piscine
programme.desc: “La piscine” est l'histoire d'une jeune femme, Rebecca, qui a décidé d'aller à la piscine. Nous suivons toutes les distractions qu'elle est capable de trouver en une journée, juste pour retarder le départ de son appartement vers la piscine. Parce que toutes les excuses sont bonnes et aussi parce qu'elle déteste la piscine, mais qu'elle a décidé d'y aller, ces distractions vont devenir de plus en plus comiques.

programme.title: Tarim le brave contre les mille et un effets
programme.desc: Alors qu'il part sauver une princesse emprisonnée dans le donjon d'un sorcier maléfique, Tarim comprend qu'il est le personnage principal d'un film, et décide de se battre contre les effets spéciaux.

programme.title: La dent
programme.desc: Pourquoi la petite souris n'a-t-elle pas récupéré la dent laissée sous l'oreiller ? Le Québécois Guy Delisle renoue avec son célèbre "mauvais père" pour illustrer avec humour la paternité. Une fenêtre sur le quotidien signée Chroniques du 9e art.

programme.title: Oripeaux
programme.desc: Dans un village isolé, une petite fille se lie d'amitié avec une meute de coyotes. Les villageois mettent brutalement fin à cette relation sans se douter du soulèvement qui les guette

programme.title: La cage
programme.desc: C'est la rencontre entre un ours prisonnier de sa cage et qui ne sait pas chanter, et un petit oiseau qui ne sait pas voler, mais qui chante très bien. Chacun va s'enrichir de l'amitié de l'autre et surmonter ses handicaps.

programme.title: Flocon de neige
programme.desc: Un jour, un petit garçon africain reçoit une lettre d'un ami et dans cette lettre, il y a un flocon de neige.

programme.title: Bang Bang !
programme.desc: Bang ! Bang ! C'est l'ouverture de la chasse. Et aussi l'anniversaire d'Éda : vingt-cinq ans. Pour fêter ça, son père lui offre un appartement qui vient d'être saisi. Happy Birthday ! Éda fuit. Elle roule vite, trop vite. Quand un chien rose surgit dans ses phares, c'est l'accident. Effrayée par l'étrange animal, elle s'engouffre dans la forêt où son père mène la chasse…

programme.title: Eclipse
programme.desc: Sur une planète éloignée, deux scientifiques venus analyser le terrain pour ses particularités magnétiques sont confrontés à un phénomène extraordinaire lié à une éclipse de lune.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Robin se fait larguer par sa copine, Annie, parce qu'il n'arrive pas à lui exprimer ses sentiments. Aidé de son chien, il va tout faire pour la récupérer.

programme.title: Mortal break-up inferno
programme.desc: La traque infernale d'un jeune homme par sa copine qui n'a pas digéré leur rupture.

programme.title: Grounded
programme.desc: Un jeune soldat sans expérience est envoyé à un poste de surveillance, au beau milieu d'un désert.

programme.title: La semaine des 4 jeudis
programme.desc: Marc a rencontré une fille qui lui a tapé dans l'oeil. Leur histoire va être d'autant plus compliquée que la semaine des quatre jeudis commence aujourd'hui.

programme.title: Fugazi
programme.desc: 2039 : depuis plus de 3 ans, Adèle travaille pour Orbit Defence, une station spatiale chargée du pilotage de drones sur la planète Terre. Aujourd'hui, tenant entre ses mains des joysticks, il ne lui reste plus qu'une mission de routine à accomplir avant de rejoindre enfin sa famille.

programme.title: A l'ombre du voile
programme.desc: Deux femmes musulmanes, une mère et sa fille, se rendent à une manifestation contre l'interdiction du voile à l'école. De retour à la maison, la mère invite sa fille à abandonner ce voile à travers une danse désespérée et troublante.

programme.title: Le pont
programme.desc: Un homme et son fils vivent au sommet d'un pic escarpé, totalement coupés du monde extérieur : le père a veillé à tenir son fils éloigné des réalités de l'humanité. Mais une nuit, l'enfant aperçoit, en bas de la falaise, une ville dont les lumières brillent.

programme.title: Paix sur la terre
programme.desc: La nuit tombe quelque part sur la terre. Ca et là, des ovoïdes traversent le ciel et s'abattent sur le sol. Peu après, on retrouve des sièges vides et des cannes à pêche plantées dans l'herbe... Tout devient extrêmement calme.

programme.title: Fugue
programme.desc: Un petit bonhomme tout à fait quelconque veut prendre soin d'une jeune pousse en la mettant au soleil. Dans un filet, il capture un nuage pour pouvoir abreuver la plante, mais celui-ci, se transformant en eau, glisse au travers des mailles. Le petit bonhomme tentera par tous les moyens de rattraper ce filet d'eau indispensable au bien-être de sa plante.

programme.title: Les yeux de la tête
programme.desc: John, un grand acteur américain, alors qu'il joue amicalement un trou au golf en France, reçoit une balle en pleine figure et perd un oeil. Il peut cependant compter sur l'excellence de la médecine européenne et l'émergence de l'économie chinoise...

programme.title: Le printemps de Bernard
programme.desc: Bernard travaille à la patinoire municipale depuis toujours, mais il s'ennuie de plus en plus, il a froid. Un soir, en rentrant chez lui, il surprend une sculpture d'athlète en bronze en train de sortir de la douche. Au tour d'un plat de nouilles propices à toutes les confidences, ils se découvrent un rêve en commun : partir à la mer.

programme.title: C'est fini avec Loïc
programme.desc: Mélanie est une comédienne heureuse. Elle doit rencontrer aujourd'hui le réalisateur qu'elle admire le plus au monde. Mais le comportement de ce dernier va transformer le (son?) rêve en cauchemar...

programme.title: La nouvelle musique
programme.desc: Dans un univers semblable au nôtre, il n'existe qu'un seule musique. Appelé “la musique”, cette suite d'accords berce l'humanité depuis des siècles. Pour Tom, bientôt au chômage, cette suite est devenue insupportable.

programme.title: Night Hunter
programme.desc: Jack Cutter est le dernier d'une longue lignée de chasseurs de vampires. Après avoir tué quelques vampires dans un restaurant de Los Angeles, il est poursuivi à la fois par la police et par d'autres vampires. Au cours de cette aventure, il rencontre une journaliste séduisante.

programme.title: Descente mortelle
programme.desc: Le corps de Yoon Seol Hee disparaît à l'Institut National d'Investigation Scientifique. Le détective Woo Joong Shik cherche des indices sur sa disparition, tandis que son mari Park Jin Han affirme qu'elle est en vie.

programme.title: Shred
programme.desc: Max et Eddy sont d'anciens snowboardeurs professionnels des années 90 qui ont ruiné leur carrière à cause de leur comportement imprudent. Travaillant désormais comme opérateurs de remontées mécaniques à Stubby Peaks, ils décident de créer un camp/équipe de snowboard pour revenir sur le devant de la scène. Kingsley Brown, leur ancien rival et président de l'Association Nationale de Snowboard, fait tout pour discréditer leur camp et empêcher ces fous dangereux de revenir dans le sport. Max et Eddy doivent alors partir à la recherche de nouveaux talents prometteurs pour rejoindre leur équipe et participer à la prochaine compétition de snowboard.

programme.title: La Prison
programme.desc: UN ANCIEN POLICIER CONDAMNÉ REJOINT UN SYNDICAT DU CRIME SECRET AU SEIN DE LA PRISONYu-gon (KIM Rae-won), ancien inspecteur de police tourmenté, est incarcéré pour un délit de fuite. En prison, il découvre que tout l'établissement est contrôlé par un détenu nommé Ik-ho (HAN Seok-kyu), qui dirige un syndicat du crime avec l'aide du directeur et des gardiens, leur fournissant ainsi l'alibi parfait. Rapidement, Yu-gon devient un membre clé de l'empire criminel d'Ik-ho.

programme.title: The Sherlock Holmes: Valley Of Fear
programme.desc: Un violoniste introverti et fumeur rencontre un médecin et le plonge dans le monde criminel.

programme.title: Elevator
programme.desc: Dans un immeuble new-yorkais, neuf personnes qui ne se connaissent pas se retrouvent piégées dans un ascenseur en panne, sans aucune issue. Mais l'un d'entre eux porte une bombe... Quand Le racisme se heurte à la cupidité alors qu'ils sont prêts à tout pour survivre, le compte à rebours pour la survie est lancé…

programme.title: Don't Be Afraid Of The Dark
programme.desc: Alex, sa fille Sally, 8 ans, et sa compagne, Kim, s'installent au manoir de Blackwood, à Rhode Island. Dès la première nuit, Sally découvre le terrible secret de la maison. Des créatures hostiles hantent les lieux et se livrent chaque nuit à divers actes de malveillance. Mais Alex et Kim accusent Sally...

programme.title: Rupture
programme.desc: Renee Morgan vit avec son fils de 12 ans dans une banlieue américaine tranquille. Alors qu'elle fait banalement ses courses, elle est violemment kidnappée et se retrouve, 24h plus tard, attachée et interrogée sur sa phobie des araignées dans un laboratoire vide et anonyme. Les scientifiques, plutOt menaçants, lui expliquent que cette phobie pourrait lui permettre d'atteindre le niveau de « rupture » nécessaire à sa mutation…

programme.title: La Bete A L'affut
programme.desc: Morane, un détenu en cavale, se réfugie chez la jeune et jolie Liliane Vermont, à qui il fait croire en son innocence. Prise dans le jeu, Lililiane veut fuir avec Morane mais s'aperçoit que ce dernier est en fait un assassin très dangereux. La jeune femme tentera malgré tout, par amour de la sauver.

programme.title: Lions et agneaux
programme.desc: Dans les montagnes enneigées d'Afghanistan, un hélicoptère de l'armée américaine est abattu par les talibans. Perdus en milieu hostile, les soldats sortis indemnes du crash luttent pour survivre en attendant d'éventuels renforts.

programme.title: Le Livre de l'Amour
programme.desc: Henry et Penny vivent à la Nouvelle-Orléans et forment un couple très amoureux, jusqu'à ce que la tragédie frappe. Henry est alors contraint de se reconstruire. Après s'être lié d'amitié avec une adolescente à la rue revêche, il décide de l'aider à construire un radeau pour traverser l'Atlantique.

programme.title: Seule Contre Tous
programme.desc: Kathryn Bolkovac, une policière du Nebraska qui a servi comme gardienne de la paix dans la Bosnie d'après-guerre, dénonce l'ONU pour avoir dissimulé un scandale de trafic sexuel.

programme.title: The Communion Girl
programme.desc: Espagne, fin des années 1980. Sara, nouvelle arrivante, essaie de s'intégrer aux autres adolescents d'une petite ville soudée de la province de Tarrgone.

programme.title: One Night in Bangkok
programme.desc: Dans ce thriller noir palpitant avec Mark Dacascos et Kane Kosugi, un tueur à gages qui passe sa nuit à préparer un meurtre engage une femme chauffeur de taxi. Va-t-elle survivre ? Et lui-même ?

programme.title: La loi du campus
programme.desc: Keanu Reeves, Kiefer Sutherland et Billy Zane mènent un groupe de lycéens justiciers qui dérape dans ce drame palpitant.

programme.title: L'Anglais
programme.desc: À peine sorti de prison en Angleterre, Wilson (Terence Stamp) arrive à Los Angeles pour enquêter sur l'étrange mort « accidentelle » de sa fille. Son principal suspect, l'agent Musiqueal Terry Valentine (Peter Fonda), riche et très bien protégé, n'est pas une cible facile.

programme.title: One Night in Bangkok
programme.desc: Dans ce thriller noir palpitant avec Mark Dacascos et Kane Kosugi, un tueur à gages qui passe sa nuit à préparer un meurtre engage une femme chauffeur de taxi. Va-t-elle survivre ? Et lui-même ?

programme.title: Staying Alive
programme.desc: Cela fait cinq ans que le Staying Alive de Tony Manero fait toujours autant fureur. Il se approche maintenant nonchalamment de son plus grand défi : le produire sur la scène de Broadway.

programme.title: Manipulation : la voisine dà côté
programme.desc: Alors que Doug a une liaison avec Lena, la jeune femme qui a loué la maison voisine de la sienne pour l'été, la mort suspecte du mari de cette dernière révèle l'existence d'une assurance vie conséquente.

programme.title: Lamborghini : lhomme derrière la légende
programme.desc: Dans l'Italie de l'après 2ème Guerre Mondiale, une course de légende oppose deux rivaux : Enzo Ferrari (Gabriel Byrne) et Ferrucio Lamborghini (Frank Grillo). Lamborghini, de ses modestes débuts consacrés à la fabrication de tracteurs à sa quête de la voiture parfaite, est devenu grâce à son génie une icône de l'industrie automobile. Mais ses passions n'ont pas été sans conséquences sur sa vie personnelle, remplie de romance comme de tragédie.

programme.title: Ransom Games
programme.desc: Deux agents du FBI à la recherche de trafiquants découvrent un étrange objet d'origine japonaise aux pouvoirs immenses. Ils vont devoir tout faire pour empêcher cet objet destructeur de tomber entre les mains d'un riche businessman.

programme.desc: Have you noticed that your memory and rational thinking disappear when you're anxious? Ruby Wax wants you to retrain your focus and attention in a digital world that's always trying to steal it. In this chat with Fearne – live from the Happy Place Festival – Ruby explains the difference between mental health and mental illness, and why she calls meditation 'mind gym'.

programme.title: Dr Julie on Triggers And Behaviour Patterns
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Julie Smith discusses why criticism hurts so deeply, explaining how your brain needs evidence rather than mantras to build self-worth and change your critical inner voice. She explores why feedback from others can trigger old wounds and how patterns developed in childhood keep replaying in adulthood.

programme.title: Ruth Langsford On Coping With Grief & Loss
programme.desc: Broadcaster Ruth Langsford opens up about navigating divorce, grief, and the emotional reality of caring for parents with dementia. From therapy breakthroughs to the power of female friendships, Ruth shares the tools that have helped her find strength in life's most difficult moments. Fearne and Ruth compare their experiences of mum guilt, and why it's so important for young boys in particular to see the women in their life working. Ruth also reveals the sliding doors moment that led her to her TV presenting career. Content warning: this episode contains conversations about grief after suicide.

programme.title: Zayn Malik's Secret to Slow Living
programme.desc: Musician Zayn talks through the quiet lifestyle he loves in Pennsylvania: painting, being outdoors, spending time with his daughter, and staying off his phone. He explains how fatherhood has changed him, whether he's the parent he thought he would be, and what impact the new depths of emotion he feels has had on his music.

programme.title: Daisy May & Charlie Cooper Discuss Their Careers And Growing Up Working Class
programme.desc: Actors Daisy May and Charlie Cooper, siblings behind the hit show This Country, join Fearne Cotton to discuss how growing up working class shaped their work ethic, creativity, and resilience. They open up about the class divide, self-doubt in breaking into television, and the £350,000 contract clause that nearly prevented their show from happening.

programme.title: What's Going Down In Fearne's WhatsApp Groups?
programme.desc: Fearne shares what's been making her laugh, what's been frustrating her, and the small moments helping her stay grounded. From outrageous chats with lifelong friends to worrying about things outside her control, this is an honest catch-up on the highs, lows and everything in between.

programme.title: Candice Carty-Williams On Queenie Is Working On It
programme.desc: This month in the Happy Place Book Club, we've been reading Queenie Is Working On It, by Candice Carty-Williams, the follow up to 2019's Queenie. In this chat with Fearne, live from the Happy Place Festival, Candice explains why she felt it was so important to write about big topics like medical racism and fertility pressures, as well as why for her characters come first and the plot is just a side quest.

programme.desc: Actor Will Poulter discusses his experiences with OCD, anxiety, and intrusive thoughts with Fearne Cotton. Will explains how OCD has manifested since childhood and talks through why finding reasons to be grateful for the lessons mental health conditions have taught can be helpful.

programme.title: On The Ground At Tommy Robinson's Rally
programme.desc: Around 60,000 people gathered at Parliament Square on 16 May for Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally, ostensibly to defend freedom, protect children, and take the country back. It was the smaller of two protests in central London, with at least a quarter of a million attending a pro-Palestine rally commemorating the 78th anniversary of the Nakba and uniting against the far-right. On the rally's main stage, a man covered in bacon played the cello.

The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: Did Boomers Create An Economy That Fails Young People?

programme.title: Why We Should Abolish Politicians
programme.desc: Yale political scientist Hélène Landemore, author of Politics Without Politicians, argues that the political systems we take for granted are no longer fit for purpose. As trust in politicians reaches historic lows across Britain, Europe and the United States, Landemore makes the case that elections alone may no longer be enough to produce governments that truly represent ordinary people.

programme.title: My Troublesome Star Ep.6
programme.desc: Actress Im Se Ra (Jang Da A) is on top of the world after becoming the youngest winner of a best actress award. Unfortunately, that same night, she's hit by a truck - and transported 25 years into the future, where she wakes up in the body of middle-aged woman Bong Cheong Ja (Uhm Jung Hwa). Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.10
programme.desc: After discovering that Jeongi is a woman, Gwanghae urges her to flee at once. Instead, Jeongi asks for just ten days—enough time to complete the celadon teacups for Yukdo. Hearing rumors that Jeongi and Gwanghae share more than a simple connection, Imhae devises a scheme and locks the two of them together in a single room.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.11
programme.desc: Gwanghae orders Gangcheon to acknowledge Jeongi's achievements and reinstate her at the Bunwon workshop. Soon after, he learns from Hwa-ryeong that Jeongi has already left with Taedo—and discovers the shocking truth that the two are not actually biological siblings. When Yukdo's life is placed in danger, Gangcheon reveals to King Seonjo and the visiting envoy that it was Jeongi who crafted the teacups. As Taedo prepares to confess his feelings to Jeongi, Gwanghae suddenly appears…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.12
programme.desc: While Gwanghae meets with the envoy, Taedo rescues Jeongi from the warehouse where she has been locked away. Watching Jeongi and Taedo walk off together, Gwanghae is flooded with memories from his past. Taedo warns Jeongi that if she chooses not to be entangled with Gwanghae any longer, she must never allow her true identity as “Jeongi” to be revealed. Back at the Bunwon, Jeongi begins learning the potter's wheel under Yukdo's guidance…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.13
programme.desc: Consumed by anger, Gwanghae coldly tells Jeongi that she is no longer the person he once knew—and that she has nothing to do with him anymore. Left in tears as she gazes at the pottery she has made, Jeongi vows to earn Gwanghae's forgiveness. Meanwhile, in front of everyone at the Bunwon, Gangcheon orders that Euldam's vessels be destroyed…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.14
programme.desc: After defeating Yukdo, Jeongi meets Gangcheon's gaze with quiet confidence, leaving him visibly shaken when he learns that her family name is “Yu.” Meanwhile, the Chief Scholar presents Gwanghae with a vessel he claims was a bribe from Royal Consort Inbin. Seeking the truth, Gwanghae visits the royal artisan Mun Saseung to confirm whether the piece was made at the Bunwon—just as Jeongi steps inside.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.15
programme.desc: Unable to bring herself to shatter Euldam's vessel, Jeongi trembles before Gangcheon until Gwanghae arrives to intervene. Determined to prove himself superior to Mun Saseung, Yukdo demands a chance from Gangcheon. Jeongi agrees to assist Mun Saseung in crafting the ceremonial vessels for the Giroyeon banquet. Watching Gwanghae's special concern for Jeongi, Taedo questions why she matters to him so deeply.

programme.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
programme.desc: When food supply in the Serengeti dwindles, the Masai Mara is a paradise for predators. As the black wildebeests, gazelles, zebras and antelopes make their yearly trip from the south of the Serengeti to the north, nature's best laid trap, the Mara River in Kenya is waiting ahead. Captivating shots filmed under water show how crocodiles prepare for the Big Hunt while other predators lurk on the banks awaiting their bounty. The biggest problems for the migratory animals are the Mara and the Tarek River, where they have to put their lives at risk to get to the other side. A great number of them die as they jump into the river and break their legs, while others are carried away by the drift or drown. Those who are not victims of the river itself risk falling prey to the crocodiles. We entered this unchartered territory, the crocodile domain by heading under water. Follow these predators in and around their habitat and watch prides of lions map out their game plan. In slow-motion, we show you the final showdown between predator and prey. Will it be a successful hunt or will the hoofed animals persevere?

programme.desc: The Grand Canyon is a steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States. The Grand Canyon is 277 miles (446 km) long, up to 18 miles (29 km) wide and attains a depth of over a mile (6,093 feet or 1,857 meters). The canyon and adjacent rim are contained within Grand Canyon National Park, the Kaibab National Forest, Grand Canyon–Parashant National Monument, the Hualapai Indian Reservation, the Havasupai Indian Reservation and the Navajo Nation. President Theodore Roosevelt was a major proponent of preservation of the Grand Canyon area and visited it on numerous occasions to hunt and enjoy the scenery.

The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yellowstone National Park is an American national park located in the western United States, largely in the northwest corner of Wyoming and extending into Montana, and Idaho. It was established by the U.S. Congress and signed into law by President Ulysses S. Grant on March 1, 1872. Yellowstone was the first national park in the U.S. and is also widely held to be the first national park in the world. The park is known for its wildlife and its many geothermal features, especially Old Faithful geyser, one of its most popular. While it represents many types of biomes, the subalpine forest is the most abundant. It is part of the South Central Rockies forests ecoregion.

programme.title: From Sardinia to Abruzzo
programme.desc: For many people, Sardinia is THE Mediterranean dream island: clichés like crystal-clear water and picturesque coastlines are reality here. Wild horses inhabit the vast unpopulated plateaux of Gesturi. In the adjacent high regions lies the kingdom of the imposing Mouflon. The curved horns of the male come in handy when battling over the females during rutting season. A breathtaking underwater world is hidden beneath the crystal clear water surrounding the island. Colourful fish, corals and sea snails live down here - as well as the basking shark! He can grow up to ten metres long, but he's completely harmless: with his huge mouth he only fishes microorganisms from the water. Sicily, off the coast at the tip of Italy's ‘boot', is the largest island in the Mediterranean. The island's most famous landmark is already visible from far-off: Etna, at 3340 metres the highest active volcano in Europe. Only 40 kilometres away another volcano looms high: Stromboli, which lies in the middle of the sea. It spews lava and fire at virtually minute intervals. From ancient times on, humans have feared the volcanoes of south Italy. Even today, there are 2500 year-old temple grounds still standing on Sicily. These days nature is re-claiming the age-old buildings – Mason bees and lizards inhabit the cracks and crevices, while lush flower meadows surround the ancient pillars. Abruzzo, lying level with Rome, is the wild heart of southern Italy. The rugged, uninhabited mountain world with its unspoilt beech forests make Abruzzo something special: this is Italy from its unfamiliar side! The inaccessible slopes are the territory of the extremely rare Apennine chamois. During rutting, the bucks engage in breakneck chases among the rocks.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: It's a dream route leading from the casino metropolis of Las Vegas, to Salt Lake City, the Mormon capital. It is a journey that follows the footsteps of the first settlers: the Mormons. They came to this desert belt of the United States during the second half of the 19th century to escape persecution and in search of the promised land. Some of them founded Las Vegas. Others moved through the canyons and over the mountains of the colossal Colorado Plateau, where they found water and pasture, to establish many small settlements. The landscapes through which they trekked, had and still have, a breathtaking and bizarre majestic beauty. Bryce Canyon, the hogbacks and the Escalante Staircase plateau are dramatic scenes of wonder formed from rock. The Pajute Indians once described Bryce Canyon as: “red rocks standing like men in a basin”.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: The vast Delta of the Mississippi River is the gateway to the South of the United States. It always has been. This is where our journey begins: through Louisiana along the banks of the mighty river, to the big inland city of New Orleans, founded long ago by the French. Further inland, sugarcane plantations and the villas of their former owners stretch as far as the eye can see. To the north, we leave the river and, taking spectacular roads, we pass through the swamplands of the Mississippi, which were once impenetrable, serving as the ideal hideout for many a runaway. Bordering Texas, where the swamplands end, is the beginning of the vast cattle country. This is home to the last remaining cowboys in the United States who, still today, maintain their French cultural heritage.

programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge

The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

programme.title: Peak Performance
programme.desc: The search for the Sandman leads Mateo and the others to the tallest mountain in the Dream World, but Lunia's hourglass puts a target on their backs.

programme.title: The Anomaly
programme.desc: A surprise visit from the Chief Inspector of the Night Bureau forces Mateo to hide Z-Blob, who goes on an adventure in the heart of Brooklyn.

programme.title: The Digiverse And Beyond, The Elemental Masters
programme.desc: Tackling a puzzle about technology in Ninjago. A riddle requires the Ninja to consider the powers and history of the Elemental Masters.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Summer is a time of rest and miracles. How nice is just to sit on the river bank with your best friends! However, everything is not so simple in our story. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear wakes up with the arrival of spring. While running around the forest, he stumbles upon a beautiful female bear. He quickly falls in love. He grabs some flowers and chocolates and rushes to her hoping to invite her for a date. Of course, Masha ruins all of his plans. The Bear does his best to get rid of the girl disturbs their idyll. Finally the female Bear notices her and demands an explanation. He tries to explain but faces with a choice –Masha or the female Bear. The Bear can't make up his mind at once and the Female Bear goes away with another bear.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear is desperately struggling against the greedy moth, which appeared in his house. Trying to save his magic box, he puts it on the porch, and Masha finds the magic hat that can make her invisible ...

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha's Songs
programme.desc: The bear is ready for anything to please Masha and She-Bear, even to become a mysterious and unpredictable Spaniard for a day. They travel to an amazing and hospitable country, where passions are seething to the sounds of the guitar and the clicking of a castanets.

programme.title: Masha's Songs
programme.desc: You don't have to go to Paris to be fashionable. It's enough to ask for help from your best friend. France will share an amazing taste in clothes and a thirst for life with Masha.

programme.title: Masha's Songs
programme.desc: A new lovely friend from foggy England got lost in the forest. Masha acts like a real Robin Hood. She wants to help this lost soul to return home. Meanwhile, the eternally hungry Wolves are trying to get to our guest.

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Horrifying Story Of Grandmother And Grandson
programme.desc: It happens that grown-up people have their own fears! For example, one grandmother was very afraid not to please her grandson. Whatever she cooked- nothing was good enough for him. Once she tried to give him a tomato, but he just threw it towards the wall! Grandma was very upset and left the house. And so he was left alone and scared- there was no one home! Much fear he had suffered until his grandmother came back! This terrible trick taught him a worthy lesson so nevertheless he was cranky ever after and ate with a terrible appetite!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: A Ghost Bike Saga Which Makes You Shiver
programme.desc: You think no one could ever be afraid of a bike...Today, you will hear an incredible... and amazing heartbreaking story... about a bicycle! There was one boy called Gosha, who was very upset when he got bicycle for his birthday as he once imagined himself rushing down the street riding that huge two-wheeled scary monster! But in reality it's so simple to ride a bike without any worries...isn't it?

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Are you sure that you really like spooky stories? What if this kind of story will get you really thrilled? Listen to one classic story and don't say that you are not shocked after all!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Super Scary Story Of A Little Boy Who Was Afraid Of Washing
programme.desc: One boy was so afraid of the water that he stopped washing himself and turned into a piggy! All his buddies ran away from him scared! But in the end he overcame his fear and began to wash his face and hands as he realized that the water can be safe and fun! The boy was very brave and even won a swimming competition!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Horrible True Story Of How A Boy Was Transferred To Another School
programme.desc: Today you will hear a story which you haven't heard before…about one boy who was transferred to another school! He was terrified so much because he thought that another strange school is full of monster-looking teachers, gym classes where you have to fight without rules and classmates-bullies! But in reality there was nothing to be afraid of because all the schools are practically the same- with normal classmates and teachers who are always ready to make you feel comfortable!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Here is another spooky story about useful inventions that might nonetheless ruin your life…just imagine…what if there is mega brain who wants to conquer the Earth with some mechanical monsters?! You might think it's a joke, but there are so many gadgets around you, can you guarantee that you are safe? Ok, ok, relax, Masha will find a way out! Oh, yeah!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Soul Freezing Tale Of Grim Forest And Tiny Timid Bug
programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Gloomy Story About The Darkest Dreams
programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear hates to say goodbye to Masha and can't stand being apart. Meanwhile, other forest dwellers are chilling in the yard not knowing that this fragile paradise is on the verge of collapse as the Bear receives a long-awaited phone call from Masha…

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha enthusiastically plays with her "dolls", but Rosie wants to be independent. She trades places with wolves and now they are under Masha's care. Rosie enjoys adult life, but everything is not that simple ...

The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

To get the desired but inaccessible delicacy, she must jump above her head or simply learn how to fly. It's good there is Masha around, who knows for sure it is always useful to dream.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.desc: In the courtyard of the Bear's house a spaceship makes an emergency landing. The aliens need to urgently replenish their supplies and return home. programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

They can't remember anything like who they are and what their mission is, but one thing they do realise very quickly is that they are not alone. Slowly the spacecraft's shocking, deadly secrets are revealed and the astronauts find that they must fight to stay alive and that their survival is more important than they could ever have imagined. Directed by Christian Alvart and also starring Cam Gigandet (Twilight), Cung Le (Tekken) and newcomer Antje Traue.

Up to his neck in bills, facing eviction from his home and in debt to a violent bookie, he desperately needs to raise some funds or else Sid will be a broken man - literally, as there are two thugs ready to break every bone in his body unless he hands over the cash he owes their boss. It doesn't help that Sid never seems to get paid for any of the work he does, as his occupation lands him in a variety of risqu situations which always end in disaster. Drastic times call for drastic measures, and the browbeaten plumber seeks employment from Dodger, a shady wheeler-dealer who can put some dubious work Sid's way. But, as always, things never seem to go exactly to plan and the beguiled plumber finds himself in further strife.

programme.title: Adventures of a Taxi Driver

From dizzy young women to frustrated housewives, Joe fancies them all, and they take a fancy to Joe. If only things were smoother at home for the put-upon cabbie. With his nagging mother, thieving teenage brother, and the attentions of an overbearing girlfriend with ideas of marriage, Joe leaves the homestead and rents the spare room at his best mate's flat. Meanwhile, he continues to find himself in an assortment of humorous sexual escapades until he accidentally becomes embroiled in a jewel heist that doesn't quite go to plan.

programme.desc: Reverend Dwight Moore is at death's door when he is transferred from his local hospital to Memorial Hospital in Chapel Hill. With all the expertise and technology of modern medicine at their disposal, doctors are still unable to find of the cause of Moore's symptoms, which include stomach pain, numbness, and hallucinations. His devoted wife Blanche remains by his side throughout his puzzling illness. She tries to comfort him by bringing his favorite banana pudding from home. When Moore's vital functions begin to shut down, a visiting specialist examines him and notices white striation lines on his fingernails, an indication of arsenic poisoning. Tests reveal that Moore has ingested more arsenic than any living person on record. Police investigators question him about his wife and discover that Blanche Moore's two previous husbands both met untimely deaths. Their bodies are exhumed and found to contain high levels of arsenic, and Blanche Moore is convicted of murder and sentenced to death.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan takes an unconscious Gayatri to the mosque where a Baba treats her. He asks Indravadhan about his whereabouts. Indravadhan does not reveal to the Baba that he is just a soldier. It is also revealed that Kuwar Singh's son has engaged in a gay relationship with a slave. Kuwar Singh scolds his son and asks him to keep in mind that, Indravadhan is not going to leave his throne. Kuwar Singh then asks his son to plan a baby as soon as possible. Kuwar Singh's son claims that he can do anything but will never plan a baby. What will Kuwar Singh's reaction be when he learns this? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri regains her consciousness and finds that Indravadhan's behavior has changed. Gayatri questions Indravadhan as to why he is doing this. Indravadhan claims that he is the one who has hurt her and it is his responsibility to take care of her. On the other hand, Kuwar's son beats up his wife and claims that he does not want to live with her. While Gayatri and Indravadhan on the other hand, are staying in the former's friend's place where they do not get sufficient food for two people. Indravadhan rejects from having the food and asks Gayatri to eat it alone. How will Gayatri convince Indravadhan to share the food? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan cries before Gayatri and claims that he had forgotten to fulfil the responsibility of a husband. Gayatri consoles Indravadhan by saying that he is a good person and knows how to fulfil the responsibilities as common man and as well as a king. Hearing this, Indravadhan leaves Gayatri and walks away. A confused Gayatri thinks as to what wrong she said to Indravadhan. On the other hand, Swarnlekha confronts Kuwar Singh and Kokila and shows her wounds to them. She tells her in-laws that she is going back to her home and is also going to complain about her husband. What will Kuwar Singh and Kokila do now? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: When Indravadhan finds Gayatri missing, he decides to search for her. On the other hand, Gayatri is held at gunpoint. She is then tied up to a chair by the baba and the family with whom Indravadhan and Gayatri were staying. Indravadhan too is held by the family and tied up to a wall. Later, Indravadhan questions Gayatri as to why she did not inform him about anything. Gayatri replies to Indravadhan that he was not ready to hear anything from her. On the other hand, Kuwar Singh and Kokila talk about Swarnlekha and her decision. They decide to talk with their son and convince him. While on the other hand, Gayatri and Indravadhan try to set themselves free and escape. Will Indravadhan and Gayatri be able to set themselves free? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan and Gayatri return home and they are confronted by Raj Mata. Raj Mata acts as though she does not know what actually had happened in the lives of Indravadhan and Gayatri. After the 'Aarti' the couple are welcomed in the house. Later, Indravadhan finds Gayatri struggling to tie a knot at her back. Indravadhan attends her and ties the knot up for her. On the other hand, Kokila meets Swarnlekha and threatens her. While on the other hand, Gayatri is suspicious as to how could Swarnlekha fall sick? Will Gayatri learn about Swarnlekha's condition? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Raj mata spots a spy in the Raj Mahal and follows her. She fails to catch up as the spy manages to evade Raj Mata. The spy then meets Kuwar Singh and gets some orders from him and meanwhile, Raj Mata informs Gayatri about the spy in the Raj Mahal. Later, Gayatri's brother meets her and invites her for an event being held at his home. When Gayatri's brother invites Raj Mata to the event, she declines the invitation. On hearing this, Indravadhan speaks up saying that he would attend the event. Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani to find out

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Ranaji and Gayatri reach her house for the Pooja. When Gayatri asks whether he is still angry or not, Ranaji says that he left his anger outside. Kuwar's spy follows the two of them to keep an eye on them. Later Damyianti thanks Ranaj for accepting Gayatri as his wife and he is then asked to wear a dhoti for the Pooja. When he struggles with draping himself, Gayatri helps him. Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek thi Rani to find out more.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri wakes up and realizes that Indravadhan has not yet returned. She decides to ask her mother where Indravadhan has gone. When Indravadhan comes back she confronts him and yells at him. Indravadhan apologizes to Gayatri and says that he failed to realize her importance in his life. He then puts a bangle around Gayatri's wrist and claims that he has given her all the rights as a queen, and as well as a wife. In return, Indravadhan requests Gayatri to forgive him. The next day, events are held at Gayatri's home in which both she and Indravadhan participate. What are the events that Indravadhan and Gayatri participate in? Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani to find out.
